brief: A cylindrical standoff 30 mm tall and 25 mm across, sitting on a 50 mm square base plate 5 mm thick, with an 8 mm hole down the middle of the standoff, in 6061-T6 aluminium.

intent.summary: A cylindrical standoff with a 30 mm height, 25 mm diameter, and an 8 mm hole in the middle, sitting on a 50 mm square base plate with a 5 mm thickness, made of 6061-T6 aluminium.
unstated: magnitude and direction of the load on the arm
